description: Land Acquisition - Kahawatta, Beliatta D/S Division, Hambantota District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically deals with the government's intention to acquire several plots of land for public purpose, providing detailed descriptions of the lands (lot numbers, names, descriptions, claimants, and extents). The content falls squarely under land and property-related matters, specifically land acquisitions, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
